candidates.title: The Killing Moon (Remastered Version)
candidates.search: Echo & The Bunnymen The Killing Moon (Remastered Version)
candidates.suits: Big, moody post-punk with strings, acoustic guitar and a central lead vocal; works where the track leads the sequence.
candidates.notes: #1 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct, up from #3 on 30 Sep: a real week-over-week climb. Spooky-season driven, so the window closes around Halloween.

candidates.title: Neon Nights
candidates.suits: Fully instrumental 1980s-style synthwave with driving synth basslines and melodic hooks; carries a montage without a lyric.
candidates.notes: Logged as a new entry at #3 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct. Single chart and no use count published, so the ranking is the signal and the scale is unknown.

candidates.title: MONTAGEM VIBRADAO
candidates.suits: Heavily distorted Brazilian phonk with high-energy percussion and vocal chops used as rhythm; suits aggressive, fast cuts.
candidates.notes: New entry at #7 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct. Single chart, no use count.

candidates.title: The Perfect Girl
candidates.suits: Cold, reverb-drenched dark synth-pop in which the vocal works as texture; suits moody, stylised footage.
candidates.notes: Named by Lightreel (3 Oct) as the track behind 'looksmaxxing' edits. Qualitative only, no use count, and a resurging older track, not a new riser, so the evidence is weak.

candidates.title: LET ME BE
candidates.search: The Second Voice LET ME BE
candidates.suits: Electronic production built around tension resolving into a sharp release; suits build-and-reveal edits.
candidates.notes: Logged as a new entry at #5 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct. Single chart, no use count. Vocal presence is unclear from the chart description.

candidates.title: Self Aware
candidates.suits: Smooth, hypnotic instrumental with a cinematic feel and no vocal; works as a background bed under talking.
candidates.notes: New entry at #2 on Metricool's global TikTok chart, 5 Oct. Single chart, no use count; a global listing, not a UK one.

candidates.title: Autumn Colors
candidates.suits: Warm, unhurried seasonal instrumental; works as a background bed for autumn-themed footage.
candidates.notes: 55k posts and filed rising by CreatorDB (7 Oct); listed independently as instrumental by Scott Social (5 Oct) at the same 55k. Two agreeing sources with a real count, well below the 500k level the run treated as saturation.

candidates.title: 90s Lo-fi Hip Hop (1612417)
candidates.suits: Steady instrumental lo-fi hip hop beat that loops without an obvious edit point; suits long shots more than cut sequences.
candidates.notes: New entry at #2 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct. Single chart, no use count. The numeric suffix in the title is a production-library ID.

candidates.title: Afternoon in Sicily (Lofi)
candidates.suits: Warm lofi with nylon-string guitar, soft hip-hop drums and outdoor ambience; suits relaxed, slow-paced edits.
candidates.notes: New entry at #8 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct. Single chart, no use count.

candidates.title: Glorious Moment
candidates.suits: Grand, swelling orchestral strings over piano chords; suits reveal and recap payoff moments.
candidates.notes: New entry at #10 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct. Single chart, bottom of it, no use count: the thinnest UK evidence in this run. The artist name contains a slashed-o in the original chart listing.

candidates.title: Pure
candidates.suits: Sparse, vocal-led song where the lyric is the point; works for text-overlay or piece-to-camera posts.
candidates.notes: 41k posts per Scott Social (5 Oct) rising to 70k per CreatorDB (7 Oct), filed rising with a heat score of 69. Two sources and roughly 70% growth in two days, the fastest acceleration measured in this run.

candidates.title: Uncasually
candidates.suits: Organic downtempo electronica with ambient synths and headroom in the mids; works as a background bed.
candidates.notes: #6 on Metricool's UK TikTok chart, 7 Oct, down from #1 on 30 Sep. That fall is why it is filed as peaking.
